This dynamic structure physically connects neighboring epithelial cells,… 323030 dynamics-of-adherens-junctions-in-epithelial-establishment,-maintenance,-and-remodeling dynamics adherens junctions epithelial establishment maintenance remodeling cadherin The epithelial cadherin (E-cadherin)-catenin complex binds to cytoskeletal components and regulatory and signali Dynamics of adherens junctions in epithelial establishment, maintenance, and remodeling The epithelial cadherin (E-cadherin)-catenin complex binds to cytoskeletal components and regulatory and signaling molecules to form a mature adherens junction (AJ). This dynamic structure physically connects neighboring epithelial cells, couples intercellular adhesive contacts to the cytoskeleton, and helps define each cell's apical-basal axis. Together these activities coordinate the form, polarity, and function of all cells in an epithelium. Several molecules regulate AJ formation and integrity, including Rho family GTPases and Par polarity proteins.
